item.title: Baltimore City Council eyes Uber, Lyft per-ride tax hike to boost revenue
item.description: A new bill introduced in December last year will see a tax increase on Ubers, Lyfts and other passenger-for-hire services.

item.title: Super Bowl LX, Bad Bunny’s halftime show fall short of ratings records
item.description: Sunday night’s Super Bowl and Bad Bunny fell short of setting records for most watched U.S. broadcast and halftime show.

item.title: Ravens hire Anthony Levine Sr. as new special teams coordinator
item.description: Anthony Levine Sr., a former Ravens player, will be Baltimore's special teams coordinator under Jesse Minter.

item.title: Indian Creek advances to IAAM B semifinals with 54-31 win over Mercy
item.description: Top-seeded Indian Creek withstood a charge by Mercy early in the second half to advance to the IAAM B Conference semifinals.

item.title: Blue Jays’ Anthony Santander to miss much of the season with shoulder injury
item.description: Blue Jays outfielder Anthony Santander, who left the Orioles in free agency last year, will miss much of the season with a shoulder injury.

item.title: Annapolis mayor defends firing of police chief amid community backlash
item.description: Mayor Jared Littmann said he was surprised that former Police Chief Ed Jackson did not resign. If he had, Littmann said he would have offered to send him out with special recognition from the city.

item.title: Anne Arundel residents voice support for pedestrian, bike path across Chesapeake Bay
item.description: Residents said they would like a shared-use pedestrian and bicycle path included in plans for a new Chesapeake Bay Bridge.

item.title: A person has been detained for questioning in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, AP sources say
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. (AP) — A person has been detained for questioning in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, AP sources say.

item.title: Person of Interest Apprehended in Nancy Guthrie’s Disappearance
item.description: (Bloomberg) -- An individual who the authorities described as a person of interest has been taken into custody regarding the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie in Arizona more than a week ago, a person familiar with the matter said on Tuesday night.

item.title: Mayor Jared Littmann faces public on police chief firing | PHOTOS
item.description: Annapolis Mayor Jared Littmann answers questions from community members about his decision to fire Police Chief Edward Jackson during a meeting of the Caucus of African American Leaders of Anne Arundel County at the Bates Legacy Center.
